Name: Sprinklers of Pelican Town
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
Ever notice how expansions add new ways to get sprinklers but in the Valley your options are few and far between?
This mod adds vanilla-friendly ways to [b]buy, upgrade, and customize sprinklers[/b] without leaving Pelican Town!

[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Modular Visual Themes:[/b] Over 25 unique sprinkler styles to pick from[/*]
[*][b]Winter Snow Effects:[/b] Optional overlay ads a little snow around your sprinklers during the winter season! ❄️[/*]
[*][b]Dual Progression Systems for Upgrades:[/b] Quest-based or automatic unlocks  This gives you the option to skip Clint's quests for any reason and unlocks the upgrade options immediately when you unlock and craft each of the recipes once.[/*]
[*][b]Enhanced Shopping:[/b] Sprinklers available at both Pierre's and JojaMart[/*]
[*][b]Craft Your Own Accessories:[/b] Pressure Nozzle and Enricher recipes[/*]
[*][b]Optional Alternative Textures Files:[/b] Customize in-game appearances with the paint bucket[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Recolor Options ✧ [/size][/b]
This mod lets you completely change how your sprinklers look with over 25 unique styles. You can recolor your sprinklers, each sprinkler tier can be a different color, and swap designs whenever you like to match your farm’s aesthetic or the current season. Enricher and both Quality & Iridium Sprinklers can be customized with an accent color too.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/37722/37722-1758142559-1682747018.png[/img]
Ghost style is slightly transparent but extra spooky! 👻

[b][size=3]✧ Upgrade Systems ✧ [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Quest-Based (Default):[/b] Clint will give simple quests to unlock upgrades at his shop. Requirements:
[list]
[*][b]Basic >> Quality Sprinklers:[/b] Farming Level 6, 2+ hearts with Clint, deliver 1 Refined Quartz[/*]
[*][b]Quality >> Iridium Sprinklers:[/b] Farming Level 9, must have completed Quality quest first, deliver 1 Battery Pack[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Automatic Option:[/b] Upgrades from Clint unlock automatically when Automatic mode is enabled (no quests required, but you still need the base sprinkler to trade in)[/*]
[*][b]Shopping:[/b] Buy sprinklers directly at:
[list]
[*][b]JojaMart:[/b] Farming levels 2, 6, 9 (Free samples with Joja Membership)[/*]
[*][b]Pierre's General Store:[/b] Farming levels 3, 7, 10 (Free samples with completed Community Center)[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Recipes:[/b] Purchase Pressure Nozzle and Enricher recipes at [b]Qi's Gem Shop[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Alternative Textures Integration ✧ [/size][/b]
In [i]Optional Files[/i] you can find an Alternative Textures (AT) version!
[list]
[*][b]How to Use:[/b] Buy the Paint Bucket from Robin and click any sprinkler[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Customization:[/b] Change styles of individual sprinklers for more variety on your farms[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Compatibility Notes ✧ [/size][/b]
Sprinklers of Pelican Town does [b]not[/b] alter sprinkler behavior (range, watering pattern, etc.) and instead focuses on visuals, upgrades, and availability.

[b][color=#c9daf8]Confirmed Compatible ✧[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23895][b]Line Sprinklers Redux[/b][/url] (highly integrated, including recolors & shop stock)[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (recommended)[/*]
[*][b]Sprinkler Activation[/b][/*]
[*][b]Immersive Sprinklers  [/b][/*]
[*][b]Sprinkler Attachments[/b] (works fine, but attachments arent recolored)[/*]
[/list][b][color=#c9daf8]Other Mods ✧[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Upgrade Sprinklers Unofficial[/b] seems unaffected, but may feel redundant[/*]
[*]Visual replacers should work fine if you [b]set visuals in this mod to Default[/b][/*]
[/list]
If you find conflicts or have compatability questions, please let me know!
If any mod author would like to discuss compatibility, please feel free to contact via DM or Discord!
